snippet.title: Mirage: Miracle Quest - Overview Trailer [EN] | AG French Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Dive into the colorful world of Mirage: Miracle Quest through a video narrated by Soanja Connac and Adrien Cantone, members of Toe Bean Club. Play as Mirage in an adventure inspired by Magical Girl stories and retro JRPGs. The game is planned for PC and consoles, and a demo is available now on Steam. (↓)
